supported_format: Classic GeoTIFF/COG metadata and uncompressed Classic TIFF strip pixels (uint8/uint16/int16/int32/float32, band 1), ESRI ASCII grids, documented DEM ASCII for terrain view
notes: Verification used the Next.js workspace UI that Electron loads (same GridMapView).
A packaged Electron executable was not launched.
Catalog inspect is metadata-first. Compressed, tiled/COG, BigTIFF, and huge rasters do not load pixel cubes.
A file named dem.asc is not a DEM unless EPSG, Units=m, and ElevationDatum are documented.
Overlay of EPSG:32630 vs EPSG:4326 is blocked. Coordinates were not reprojected.
Hillshade/slope/NDVI/raster algebra are not registered capabilities.
